The '''Gravlex Med system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]].
